final_answer:
Three high-risk user requirements are not fully verified. The other 23 HIGH-risk URS items each have at least one passing test that traces back to them.

**1. URS-EBR-009 (FRA-042): no verification exists.** This requirement says a target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell must be rejected for GMP runs. Its configuration item, CS-EBR-03 (hard-stop range check), has no VERIFIES link, and no test case covers the MOI range. The only EBR calculation test, TC-OQ-EBR-04 (TX-0083), verifies the vector-volume calculation (URS-EBR-007 / CS-EBR-02), not the MOI range rejection. The failure modes this control mitigates (FM-05 MOI above target, FM-06 MOI below target) are HIGH-RPN risks, so this is a real gap.

**2. URS-INC-004 (FRA-004): verified on three incubators but failed on INC-03.** TC-OQ-INC-04 (door-open alarm within 60 s) passed on INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04. On INC-03 it failed (TX-0023: alarm at 142 s). There is no re-execution in the log. DEV-26-011 is closed, but its own impact assessment says the "INC-03 door alarm function not verified." The corrective action, CAPA-26-012 (replace the door switch and re-execute TC-OQ-INC-04, due 2026-03-31), is still OPEN with no re-test on record. The problem recurred in June: DEV-26-033 (a major deviation) records that the INC-03 door was not fully latched during PPQ26-02.

**3. URS-CRF-001 (FRA-020): verified only with an empty chamber.** The requirement is that freezing profile CRF-P01 be held within ±2 °C "with a representative load." The only test, TC-OQ-CRF-01 (TX-0063), was run on an empty chamber. No PQ protocol exists for the controlled-rate freezer, and the FM-13 control "PQ by engineering runs" is not backed by any approved protocol in the database. PPQ-001 is not approved yet, so it cannot count as verification.

**Caveat (not counted above):** URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 have passing re-tests on FRZ-80-02 (TX-0091, TX-0092, 2026-04-24), so they are verified on paper. However, DEV-26-021 (MAJOR, compressor failure, chamber reached about -36 °C) was closed without any loaded requalification on record. The only loaded mapping (PQ-ULT-01) predates the failure, so a reviewer may want to confirm whether the post-repair work needed a loaded PQ.
